KPMG 20170508-20180331PUNGWE Revision samarbetet med Mozambique i Pungwefloden

description.narrative: Audit Pungwe River Integrated Water Resources Management phase PPII

Insatsen handlar om ett avrop på ramavtal för revision av samarbetet med Mozambique om Pungwefloden, Insats 73000674 Pungwe River Integrated Water Resources Management PPII.
Sida avslutar samarbetet med Mozambique i enlighet med gällande avtal. På senaste årsmötet beslöts att Sida skulle upphandla slutrevisionen med anledning av att man ville utföra en fördjupad revision i enlighet med bifogad uppdragsbeskrivning och sidas riktlinjer för slutrevision med tanke på det stora stöd PP2 fått liksom det framtida ägarskapet av projektets tillgångar.
Upphandlingen har genomförts i enlighet med ramavtalet för revision.

The audit of ARA Centro and PP2 was undertaken in May 2017, auditors' visit to ARA centro took place 14 - 20 May 2017. The audit concerned the period 1 January, 2016-30 April, 2017 . The audit report was submitted to Sida on 30 June 2017 and was unqualified. However, Sida's own records showed that there was a difference between the amount reported by the project and the full amount paid out by Sida. Dialogue with KPMG and the project partners continued throughout the fall 2017. It has now been confirmed that the errors in reporting have taken place in periods prior to the one audited by KPMG. The report has therefore been approved and the invoices for audit paid.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
